python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# FY1981 runs from Oct 1980 to Sep 1981
# From the table:
# - FY1982 columns (Oct, Nov, Dec) are Oct 1980, Nov 1980, Dec 1980 (FY81 months)
# - FY1981 columns (Jan-Sep) are Jan 1981 - Sep 1981 (FY81 months)

fy1981_data = [
    64216,  # Oct (FY1982 column, but Oct 1980)
    56838,  # Nov (FY1982 column, but Nov 1980)
    76875,  # Dec (FY1982 column, but Dec 1980)
    59099,  # Jan (FY1981)
    53969,  # Feb (FY1981)
    54216,  # Mar (FY1981)
    57198,  # Apr (FY1981)
    54608,  # May (FY1981)
    55619,  # Jun (FY1981)
    58486,  # Jul (FY1981)
    53095,  # Aug (FY1981)
    53698   # Sep (FY1981)
]

print("FY1981 Monthly Net Budget Outlays (millions of dollars):")
print(fy1981_data)
print(f"\nCount: {len(fy1981_data)}")

# Calculate population standard deviation
pop_std = statistics.pstdev(fy1981_data)
print(f"\nPopulation Standard Deviation: {pop_std}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(pop_std, 2)}")

# Also show mean for verification
mean = statistics.mean(fy1981_data)
print(f"\nMean: {mean}")
EOF
